access.title: Security & access
access.subtitle: Onboard server · replicated to Earth with delay

authModes.onboard: Onboard server session (simulated on the tablet).

access.signInOnboard: Sign in with an onboard server account
access.accessExpires: The access token (JWT) expires in {{eta}} and renews automatically.
access.refreshExplain: Each refresh token works only once. If someone reuses an already-used one (possible theft), every session in that family is revoked and Earth is notified.
access.rotatedBody: The previous refresh token no longer works.
access.reuseBody: All sessions on this device were revoked. Please sign in again.
access.pinNone: No PIN. With a PIN you can unlock the tablet even if the server does not respond.
access.pinWeak: PIN too simple. Avoid repeated digits or sequences.
access.pinExpired: Offline unlock expired: sign in with your password.
access.policyBody: Lockout after {{attempts}} failed attempts for {{minutes}} min. {{ttl}}-min access token with rotating refresh. Offline PIN valid for {{hours}} h since last sign-in.
access.lockedUntil: Account locked due to failed attempts until {{time}}.
access.mustChangeBody: Mission control created your account with a one-time password. Choose a new one to continue.
access.passwordPolicy: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
access.passwordReuse: Choose a password different from the temporary one.
access.passwordChangedBody: You can now choose your mission.
access.createHint: A temporary password is generated and shown ONCE; only its bcrypt hash is stored. Astronauts are assigned to the current mission.
access.createdOnce: Write these down: they won't be shown again
access.createdBody: The user must change the password at first sign-in.
access.delegatedBody: You can unlock accounts, reset PINs and register spare tablets for your mission. Every action is audited and reported to Earth. It grants no access to medical or wellbeing data.
access.reportedToEarth: Action audited and reported to Earth.
access.deniedBody: Your role does not allow this action.
access.devicesBody: Only a registered tablet can open triage without a session. The spare generates its own credential; the server stores only its fingerprint.

comms.title: Earth communications
comms.subtitle: Link, delay and outbound queue

profileHint.leo: Near-zero delay; short outages every orbit.
profileHint.mars: 12 min each way (3 to 22 depending on position) and a daily blackout.
profileHint.demo: 45 s each way and a 1-min outage every 6 min, to see it live.

comms.forceOfflineBody: Everything stays queued on board and goes out on reconnect.

earth.title: Earth inbox
earth.demoSubtitle: Simulation: what each team has received

scope.missionControl: Mission control sees compliance, fitness (yes / not confirmed), emergencies and audit. Never medical or wellbeing detail.
scope.flightSurgeon: The flight surgeon sees medical escalations and triage reports. For wellbeing, only status and escalated alerts.
scope.behavioralHealth: Behavioral health sees confidential wellbeing detail: questionnaires and conversations.

earth.pending_one: {{count}} message still on its way (not visible yet).
earth.pending_other: {{count}} messages still on their way (not visible yet).
